role: missed-items sweep — fleet-wide .ufo/reports round dirs vs MANIFEST closure entries
assignment: Read-only classification of main fleet-root report directories and report files; no pruning or status changes.
verdict: AGREE on souji rounds 1–4: all four root reports have matching MANIFEST closure rows. Fleet-wide sweep found 37 root report files without a matching closure lane-round or exact report-path reference; classifications below only, with no action recommended.

directory_reconciliation.classification: 9 dirs (61–65 and 70–73) have train-only records, not closure entries. The other 14 (32, 66–69, 74–79, 83–85) have no closure round entry. Round 32 is mentioned as kumitate round 32 in the 12-hour phase-2 ops note, but there is no lane-round closure/path association for the root report.

report_classification.classification_note: The 22 nonclosure-only reports map to train or legacy work entries, not closure entries. The 37 unpaired files have no matching MANIFEST lane-round row or exact round-N/file.md report-path reference; this is a report/ledger reconciliation finding, not an assessment of lane work or a removal proposal.

method.round_directories: Direct child directories of .ufo/reports matching round-N; direct *.md files classified by lane basename.
method.row_identity: Use entry.round plus lane id. PROTOCOL.md:283-292 says lane_rounds annotates a lane counter and never re-keys the row; explicit report-path mentions are also recognized, including noncanonical report filenames.
method.known_exception: MANIFEST.json:197 explicitly names round-1/kengaku-shokunin.md and round-1/web-properties-publishing.md as off-contract filenames; they are referenced closure evidence, not unpaired files.
